sentences.en: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
sentences.zh: 我相信情况会变得更好。

sentences.en: I had difficulty convincing her of the dangers of smoking.
sentences.zh: 说服她吸烟的危害很困难。

sentences.en: The grocer managed to convince his customers of his honesty.
sentences.zh: 杂货商设法让顾客相信他的诚实。

senses.zh: 使相信，说服，使承认,使明白,使确信,使悔悟，使认错罪
